Defaults external finding offsets to UTF-8 bytes

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_with_external_redaction, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=[90, 111, 195, 171, 32, 101, 109, 97, 105, 108, 101, 100, 46], filename="external-findings-default.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{}")
    findings = [{"end": 4, "label": "inspection_person", "score": 0.99, "start": 0}]
    max_findings = 8
    result = await extract_with_external_redaction(input, config, findings, None, max_findings)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
